sourceEnglishObjective: Describe and record a repaired deck section
sourceEnglishSpeaking: Ask for a photo of a deck repair before the crew covers it.
candidateObjective: 補修した野地板の範囲を説明し、写真と寸法で記録する。
candidateFocus: ～前に places the photo before covering. ～まで prohibits covering until inspection; ～た後 gives the after-repair photo sequence.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 作業員は補修の前後に写真を撮ります。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: The workers take a photo before and after the repair.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 作業員は損傷した範囲を職長に見せます。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: A worker shows the damaged area to the foreman.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 作業員は損傷した合板を交換します。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: The workers replace the damaged plywood.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 作業員はその範囲を測り、寸法を伝えます。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: A worker measures the section and gives the measurement.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 職長は覆う前に補修した範囲を確認します。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: The foreman checks the repaired section before covering it.

archivedSpeaking.opening: 損傷した範囲を見せてください。補修の前後に写真を撮り、寸法を伝えてください。私が確認するまで覆わないでください。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Ask for a photo of a deck repair before the crew covers it.

curriculumAdaptationNote: Preserve the current source scene: during tear-off, the crew finds deck damage; the foreman requests the area, before/after photos and a size measurement; workers replace damaged plywood; a photo is taken before covering; the foreman checks before covering; the photo records what will be hidden. Deck and sheathing require separate contextual Japanese senses, and the photo is documentation rather than proof of structural adequacy. Archived speaking adds a measurement request beyond the source speaking objective. Current curriculum has no authored verb-example list; archived forms remain conditional evidence. No selected learner/audio text or saved-progress identity is created.

cards.reviewNote: Deck here is the structural roof deck, not the whole roof covering; archived 野地板 needs a contextual deck versus sheathing decision before a dictionary face is selected.
Covered area means the area that will be covered after repair. Archived 覆われる範囲 may suggest an already covered zone; confirm timing and what remains visible in the record.
Source distinguishes sheathing from deck in separate cards. Archived 下地板 may collapse them; qualified roofing/Japanese dictionary review must settle the product and structural senses.

cards.sourceSpanish: Tomen una foto del área reparada antes de cubrirla.
cards.sourceEnglish: Take a photo of the repaired area before covering it.
cards.archivedJapanese: 覆う前に補修した範囲の写真を撮ってください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Take a photo of the repaired area before covering it.
cards.reviewNote: Photograph before covering is the source instruction. Confirm that the photo is a documentation step, not evidence by itself that the repair is technically adequate.

cards.candidateJapanese: 損傷した範囲を見せてください。
cards.archivedJapanese: 損傷した範囲を見せてください。

cards.sourceEnglish: Take a photo before and after the repair.
cards.candidateJapanese: 補修の前後に写真を撮ってください。
cards.archivedJapanese: 補修の前後に写真を撮ってください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Take a photo before and after the repair.

cards.sourceSpanish: No lo cubran hasta que yo lo revise.

cards.archivedEnglish: Do not cover it until I check it.
cards.reviewNote: Do not cover until I check it gives the foreman the check in this scene. Confirm inspection/authorization scope under the site process before scoring this construction instruction.

reader.sourceSpanish: Durante el desmontaje, la cuadrilla encontró un área dañada en la cubierta.
reader.sourceEnglish: During the tear-off, the crew found a damaged area on the deck.

reader.archivedEnglish: During the tear-off, the crew found a damaged area on the deck.
reader.reviewNote: Tear-off reveals a damaged deck section. Archived 野地板 is plausible but may narrow structural deck to one sheathing product; hold contextual material sense.

reader.archivedJapanese: 職長は「損傷した範囲を見せてください」と言います。

reader.archivedJapanese: 補修の前後に写真を撮ってください。
reader.archivedEnglish: Take a photo before and after the repair.

reader.sourceSpanish: Los obreros reemplazan el triplay dañado.
reader.sourceEnglish: The workers replace the damaged plywood.

reader.sourceSpanish: Tomen una foto del área reparada antes de cubrirla.

reader.archivedEnglish: Take a photo of the repaired area before covering it.
reader.reviewNote: The photo-before-cover instruction is source-authored. Keep it as documentation, separate from any approval of repair adequacy or permission to cover.

reader.sourceSpanish: No lo cubran hasta que yo lo revise.
reader.sourceEnglish: Do not cover it until I check it.
reader.archivedJapanese: 私が確認するまで覆わないでください。
reader.archivedEnglish: Do not cover it until I check it.
reader.reviewNote: The foreman says not to cover until he checks it; avoid converting this scene instruction into universal authorization or completed structural acceptance.

reader.sourceSpanish: La foto de la reparación es el registro de lo que queda en el área cubierta.
reader.sourceEnglish: The repair photo is the record of what stays in the covered area.
reader.archivedJapanese: 補修写真は、覆われる範囲に何が残るかを示す記録です。
reader.archivedEnglish: The repair photo is the record of what stays in the covered area.
reader.reviewNote: The repair photo records what remains in the covered area. Archived Japanese may imply the photo itself demonstrates the hidden condition or repair adequacy; confirm record versus proof sense.
